data.description: Atin decision 2026-09-30. c11's model is workspaces → areas → tabs: a pane becomes an area, a surface (terminal/browser/markdown leaf) becomes a tab, a sidebar entry is a workspace and is never called a tab. Depth: everything people and agents see (UI text + 7 localizations, CLI commands/flags/help, refs area:N/tab:N, socket methods + JSON keys, env vars C11_AREA_ID/C11_TAB_ID, metadata keys, skills/docs/CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md) plus c11's own Swift identifiers in Sources/, CLI/, tests. vendor/bonsplit and ghostty internals keep their names; rename only at the c11 boundary. Old names keep working as hidden aliases (commands, flags, refs, env vars). JSON emits new and old keys for one release, old keys marked for removal. tmux-compatible commands (kill-pane, capture-pane, swap-pane, pipe-pane…) untouched. Update consumers: Overwatch launcher, Stage 11 skills, lattice skills. Alias tests + dual-key JSON tests. One CLAUDE.md line states the vocabulary and hidden-alias rule.
data.title: c11: vocabulary rename, workspaces → areas → tabs (pane → area, surface → tab) with hidden aliases

data.body: Map: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-atin-Projects-Stage11-code-c11/c92ddfe8-b375-47cc-9262-d6db56ef1d84/scratchpad/c11-248-rename-map.md . Contract (rulings): /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-atin-Projects-Stage11-code-c11/c92ddfe8-b375-47cc-9262-d6db56ef1d84/scratchpad/c11-248-contract.md . ~480 files; public contract 18 CLI cmds, 38 socket methods, ~70 JSON key families; Swift ~1,900 ids / ~38k occurrences. PR1 visible layer (A strings, B wire+aliases, D docs/skills, E tests), then Swift passes 0/1/1b/2/3 as scripted compiler-checked PRs, then F consumers.

PHASES (Atin rule: deferred items are later phases of this ticket, not new tickets).
P1 visible layer, PR1: UI strings + 7 locales, CLI/socket/JSON/refs/env/metadata with hidden aliases, AppleScript workspace class, skills/docs/CLAUDE.md, Python tests + alias/dual-key tests. Done: merged, CI green, no user-visible pane/surface outside tmux-compat, aliases tested.
P2 bonsplit UI strings values-only fork PR + submodule bump. Done: no 'Pane'/'surface' in bonsplit en/ja/ko/ru/uk/zh strings visible in c11.
P3 Swift internals, scripted compiler-checked passes 0 (typealias Tab), 1 (Tab->Workspace), 1b (bonsplit TabID names), 2 (Surface/Panel->Tab), 3 (Pane->Area) + file renames. Done: each merged green; persisted keys pinned; session restore verified on a tagged build.
P4 external consumers: overwatch launcher/skills, Gregorovich, Stage 11 + lattice skills, bakeoff. Done: consumers read new keys, smoke run.
P5 web/ site vocabulary (+ i18n). Done: merged, no pane/surface in site copy.
P6 test class/function renames. Done: merged green.
P7 debug-only keys/methods (debug.panel_snapshot etc.) with aliases. Done: merged, test harness updated.
P8 Go daemon/remote CLI table aliases. Done: remote CLI accepts new names, help shows new.
P9 educational-materials repo copies. Done: PR merged in that repo.
P10 terminal validation: fresh validator on main + Atin visual pass script.

P4 F1 landed: overwatch PR #1 merged (a572cc3, seat.sh reads .surface_ref // .tab_ref); ~/.local/bin/Gregorovich made tolerant in place (backup in orchestrator scratchpad). F2 held until a c11 release ships the new names: overwatch PR #2 '[hold until c11 release]' (stacked on #1; retarget to main), bakeoff patch at scratchpad/f2-bakeoff.patch. Finding: on shipped 0.66.1, a tab:N ref passed to --surface resolves to the WRONG tab silently, so nothing may teach tab:N until the release; skill sync waits for the release.

P3 Swift passes PARKED at operator request (release first). Branch c11-248-c @44c601a79 (pushed). Pass 0 green; pass 1 scripted, 2 compile errors left; 1b/2a/2b/3 not run. Resume note: ~/Projects/Stage11/code/c11-worktrees/c11-248-c-RESUME.md (tooling in scripts/vocab-rename/ on that branch; re-run on fresh main after PR 1 + release).

P1 MERGED: #472 squash 572625473 (CI green at 1d55713d8; fresh Opus review FAIL→PASS in 2 rounds + merge attestation). P2 bonsplit#9 merged and pinned (05e158a). Related #473 (debug save/load race) merged c1d44c7cf. Remaining: P3 Swift passes (parked, c11-248-c), P4 F2 held for 0.67.0 (overwatch PR #2, bakeoff patch) + skill sync after release, P5-P9, P10 validation incl. live tests_v2 run (needs sandbox C11-244 or a quiet window).

Plan (Cairn, 2026-09-30): parked until Release Captain (surface:398) reports 0.67.0 installed. Then: skill sync from origin/main; land overwatch PR #2 (retarget to main) + bakeoff patch (scratchpad f2-bakeoff.patch); then P3 (resume c11-248-c per c11-248-c-RESUME.md, re-run scripts on fresh main), then P5-P9, then P10 (live tests_v2 via C11-244 sandbox).

Post-release: skill sync live (16 skills = origin/main 7cec0946c); bakeoff patch applied; F2 overwatch PR #2 HELD until Atlas c11 >= 0.67.0 (Atlas on 0.64.0, seats read seat.sh + lattice skills there), being rebased onto overwatch main. P3 resumed: worker C2 on branch c11-248-p3 off v0.67.0, reusing scripts/vocab-rename from c11-248-c.

P3A PR #482 review r1 FAIL (Codex Sol): pass 1 generator classified per file, so Bonsplit leaf tabs (tabs(inPane:), selectedTab, allTabIds, TabID, TabInfo, browser panels, blueprint tabs:) were renamed workspace* in ~10 files. Safety checks clean (CodingKeys pin + test, AppleScript @objc names, no literal changes, vendor untouched, dlog gates). Repair r1 with C2: per-binding classification in the generator + a zero-hit leaf-misname check script.

P3A #482: review r2 FAIL (closure binders → 'ws' fallback; checker blind to fallback names), r3 FAIL tool-only (partial-call LEAF_RHS matches end the tail scan early; source tree clean, 0 misnames by independent sweep). Round 4 (last) with C2: fix the scan + scripts/vocab-rename/test_rename.py fixtures for every leaf source × binding form.
P3A MERGED: #482 squash 7b843a136 (review PASS r4, CI green at 71484943f). P3B (passes 2a/2b) started on c11-248-p3b.

P3B #483 review r1 FAIL: Ghostty/IOSurface handles renamed tab* (ruling 8), Bonsplit leaf TabIDs named tabId (createTab results, taint file exclusions), reverse case in tests, checker blind to both. Safety clean. Repair r1 with C2 (keep-domain taint, extended leaf sources, independent two-direction checker validated against the failing tree).

P3B #483 review r2 FAIL (Ghostty raw handles/readiness renamed tab*, [TabID] results + forTabId labels, checker false zero). Orchestrator decision: invert to evidence-only renaming (types, c11-tab-type members, evidenced locals; Bonsplit leaf by annotation; Ghostty wrapper domain always kept); gate = check-evidence proves every rename; residual old internal words tracked as debt.

P3B MERGED: #483 squash c6416bd63 (evidence-only, 3,765 proven renames, review r3 PASS, CI green). Residual old internal words ~14.7k tokens tracked as debt (follow-up evidence rule could recover). P3C (Pane→Area) started on c11-248-p3c.

P3 DONE: #484 merged 0ad9f484e (Pane→Area, evidence-only; review r2 PASS; host-test failure set identical to main). Process finding: CI host step is advisory with 44 pre-existing failures on main; per-PR failure-list diff used as the gate (0 new for #482/#483/#484). Next: P6 test names (C2), P7 debug keys, P8 Go remote CLI, P5 web, P9 educational repo.
P9 DONE: educational-agentic-engineering-materials PR #1 merged (vocabulary refresh, 9 files, text-only).

P5 DONE: web PR #486 merged f4cc5cce6 (site + 19 locales; review PASS, no findings; site undeployed). P8 #485 reviewed by orchestrator (legacy-wire value fix added), awaiting compat-tests. P7 #487 review PASS + 4 small follow-ups in progress. P6 #488 in review.
P7 DONE: #487 merged 0a7121f49 (review PASS + 4 follow-ups attested; host-test failure set identical to main). P8 DONE: #485 merged 661b23324. Remaining: P6 #488 in review.
